theorems.name: other_device_ignored
theorems.doc: (S) A packet for another device changes nothing.
theorems.statement:
theorem other_device_ignored (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64) :
    set_name false len same lw now = ok .Ignore
theorems.proof:
theorem other_device_ignored (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64) :
    set_name false len same lw now = ok .Ignore := by
  simp [set_name]

theorems.name: long_name_kept_old
theorems.doc: (S) A name over 64 bytes is refused: the stored name stays (upstream stores it empty).
theorems.statement:
theorem long_name_kept_old (b : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : 64 < len.val) : set_name b len same lw now = ok .Ignore
theorems.proof:
theorem long_name_kept_old (b : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : 64 < len.val) : set_name b len same lw now = ok .Ignore := by
  have : len > MAX_NAME_LEN := by have := max_len_val; scalar_tac
  simp [set_name, this]

theorems.name: unchanged_name_not_written
theorems.doc: (S) The name the device already has is announced, never written.
theorems.statement:
theorem unchanged_name_not_written (len : Std.U32) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : len.val ≤ 64) : set_name true len true lw now = ok .Announce
theorems.proof:
theorem unchanged_name_not_written (len : Std.U32) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : len.val ≤ 64) : set_name true len true lw now = ok .Announce := by
  have : ¬ len > MAX_NAME_LEN := by have := max_len_val; scalar_tac
  simp [set_name, this]

theorems.name: writes_spaced
theorems.doc: (S) A write happens only when allowed: none since boot, or the last one at least 10 s before (no flash wear by a flood).
theorems.statement:
theorem writes_spaced (b : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : set_name b len same lw now = ok .Store) : Spec.write_allowed lw now
theorems.proof:
theorem writes_spaced (b : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : set_name b len same lw now = ok .Store) : Spec.write_allowed lw now := by
  intro t ht
  subst ht
  have hi := interval_val
  by_cases hb : b = true
  · subst hb
    by_cases hl : len > MAX_NAME_LEN
    · simp [set_name, hl] at h
    by_cases hs : same = true
    · subst hs; simp [set_name, hl] at h
    have hs' : same = false := by simpa using hs
    subst hs'
    by_cases hw : (core.num.U64.saturating_sub now t).val < MIN_WRITE_INTERVAL_MS.val
    · simp [set_name, hl, lift, hw] at h
    · have hv := sat_sub64_val now t
      have h1 : 10000 ≤ (core.num.U64.saturating_sub now t).val := by
        rw [← hi]; omega
      rw [hv] at h1
      constructor <;> omega
  · have : b = false := by simpa using hb
    subst this; simp [set_name] at h

theorems.name: store_only_valid
theorems.doc: (S) A name is stored only when it is for this device, fits, and differs from the stored one.
theorems.statement:
theorem store_only_valid (b : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : set_name b len same lw now = ok .Store) : b = true ∧ len.val ≤ 64 ∧ same = false
theorems.proof:
theorem store_only_valid (b : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (lw : Option Std.U64) (now : Std.U64)
    (h : set_name b len same lw now = ok .Store) : b = true ∧ len.val ≤ 64 ∧ same = false := by
  by_cases hb : b = true
  · subst hb
    by_cases hl : len > MAX_NAME_LEN
    · simp [set_name, hl] at h
    by_cases hs : same = true
    · subst hs; simp [set_name, hl] at h
    refine ⟨rfl, by have := max_len_val; scalar_tac, by simpa using hs⟩
  · have : b = false := by simpa using hb
    subst this; simp [set_name] at h

theorems.name: long_datagram_dropped
theorems.doc: (S) A datagram over 128 bytes is not decoded (upstream decodes up to 1500 bytes into its 1 KiB heap: a long `SetName` exhausts it, the device resets).
theorems.statement: theorem long_datagram_dropped (len : Std.U32) (h : 128 < len.val) : datagram_ok len = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem long_datagram_dropped (len : Std.U32) (h : 128 < len.val) : datagram_ok len = ok false := by
  have : MAX_DATAGRAM.val = 128 := by unfold MAX_DATAGRAM; rfl
  have h2 : ¬ len ≤ MAX_DATAGRAM := by scalar_tac
  simp [datagram_ok, h2]

SetName.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive SetName where
| Ignore : SetName
| Announce : SetName
| Store : SetName
SetName.upstream_note: the outcomes of upstream's SetName branch: ignored (other id), stored and announced; the port adds announce-only

datagram_ok.lean:
def datagram_ok (len : Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  ok (len <= MAX_DATAGRAM)
datagram_ok.upstream_note: the postcard decode of every datagram, which the port does only for datagrams within MAX_DATAGRAM

MIN_WRITE_INTERVAL_MS.upstream_note: port-only: upstream writes the config sector on every SetName (pico_2w/src/main.rs:279); the port spaces writes 10 s apart

MAX_DATAGRAM.upstream_note: upstream decodes up to the 1500-byte receive buffer into its 1 KiB heap; the port bounds what it decodes (128 bytes, a valid packet is at most 85)

set_name.lean:
def set_name
  (for_me : Bool) (len : Std.U32) (same : Bool) (last_write : Option Std.U64)
  (now : Std.U64) :
  Result SetName
  := do
  if for_me
  then
    if len > MAX_NAME_LEN
    then ok SetName.Ignore
    else
      if same
      then ok SetName.Announce
      else
        match last_write with
        | none => ok SetName.Store
        | some t =>
          let i ← lift (core.num.U64.saturating_sub now t)
          if i < MIN_WRITE_INTERVAL_MS
          then ok SetName.Announce
          else ok SetName.Store
  else ok SetName.Ignore
set_name.upstream_note: the id check, the String<64> conversion (unwrap_or_default), the save and the multicast confirmation, as one decision

MAX_NAME_LEN.upstream_note: the heapless String<64> a name must fit
